PiP clamp 224x170...880x640 px . suppressed canvas label ids [ctx-cerebral-cortex]' and then exits 4 (browser unavailable, the documented path; Chrome is denied in this sandbox); (2) a three.js scene bridge installed via Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument using three r169's own __THREE_DEVTOOLS__ 'observe' hook, which is what makes the RENDERED helper geometry and the rendered mesh set readable from the browser lane; (3) block Q0-Q6 (~120 new assertions/measurements): Q1 reads each helper sheet's planeGeometry args, grid extents/steps, group position and material back out of the live scene and requires them to equal the spans the DOM clip sliders (i.e. CLIP_BOUNDS) publish, centred on the box midpoints, at the parked clip value, with ~4 au cells and the unchanged visual/raycast contract, and OFF -> 0 sheets; Q2 solos each division and requires the legend checkboxes, the taxonomy-tree dim state AND the rendered scene to follow, requires the scene after a solo to be name-identical to the scene after asking for the same regions through the per-region checkboxes (two independent UI paths, one render), checks 'nothing persisted', and calibrates a real Space keypress on a plain checkbox before asserting the division checkbox; Q3 asserts four handles with distinct corner naming + live size + topmost-at-centre hit testing, then real pointer drags (Input.dispatchMouseEvent) per corner with a distinct per-corner pointer vector, requiring the window rect and the store key to move by exactly that corner's rule, the docked card's right/bottom edges to stay put, the window box to move in one of the two documented dock regimes, and an oversized drag to stop exactly on SECTION_PIP_SIZE_MAX; Q4 sweeps the transverse planes PLAN.md 4 measured the artefacts on and requires the painted division set to equal the shipped rule's set, with Plates and PiP agreeing; Q5 requires the cortex label gone from the canvas DOM and from the canvas' scoped accessibility subtree, a 36-point hover sweep and a 49-point click sweep never announcing it, the contour still drawn and hit-testable, and the thalamus envelope KEEPING its chip; Q6 hygiene. EVIDENCE CONTRACT: scripts/verify/audit.mjs exists (226 KB, non-empty), `node --check scripts/verify/audit.mjs` exit 0, `npm run check` exit 0, `npm run validate` exit 0 (0 errors/0 warnings). FULL NON-BROWSER SWEEP after the change, every one exit 0: build; verify:pipeline 138/138 parts . 599204 tris . 0 problems; verify:plane 10827 assertions; verify:somatotopy 45/45; verify:cortical-lobes 519/519; verify:pip-contract; verify:audit-checks 92/0; verify:closure-bite 7/7; verify:boundary-contract 22/22; verify:a11y-contract 38/38; verify:budget-report 5/0; plane-helper-extent 196/0; division-toggles 250/0. FINDINGS THAT CONTRADICT A PLAN OR SHIPPED CLAIM (each with its command/number): F1 item 3 - PLAN 3's 'the opposite corner stays put' holds only for NW: the card is CSS-docked right/bottom (sectionPip.css:51-54), so a width change ALWAYS moves the left edge and a height change ALWAYS moves the top edge, while PIP_CORNER_EDGES (SectionPiP.tsx:443-451) claims NE fixes left+bottom and SW fixes right+top and SE fixes left+top; the dragged SE handle cannot follow the pointer at all (its own corner is the pinned one). The pip task records this as an accepted limitation; Q3 therefore asserts the size rule plus the dock invariant and PRINTS the per-corner screen readout instead of encoding the false edge claim. F2 item 4 - the fix silently drops 6 measured, floors-CLEARING division bodies (not just slivers): an earlier absorption collapses a span's shoelace area and a later pass absorbs it into a DIFFERENT division. Traced: ctx-hemisphere-l y=32 frontal raw 20 own vertices / 41.82 au arc / 129.46 au2 -> painted as occipital; z=15 insula 35.04 -> 1.59 au2 -> absorbed into limbic, then the whole 69-vertex loop painted as one 635 au2 temporal run. Measured over 218 planes x both ribbons (1836 painted runs, 0 floor violations, 0 metric mismatches, 164/170 'geometry but no painted run' rows sub-threshold-only, the remaining 6 this new class). The committed gate asserts nothing about this class. F3 item 4 - the committed gate's per-plane tables slice ctx-hemisphere-l only, while the canvas paints both ribbons (sectionAssets.ts:168-171): e.g. y=0 the gate reports 3 runs/3 divisions and both ribbons give 6 runs/4 divisions. My browser expectations (ARTEFACT_PLANES) are therefore measured from BOTH ribbons and differ from the architect's pre-fix table: at y=14/16 limbic has a real right-ribbon body, and at y=32 temporal keeps a 141.5 au2 run after absorption, so the natural 'TEMPORAL absent at y=32' assertion would have been WRONG about the shipped rule. F4 item 5 - the label is gone from SectionCanvas' own canvas DOM and accessibility subtree (asserted in Q5), but the exact string 'Cerebral cortex (context envelope)' still reaches the app's accessibility tree on the same screen (info rail, taxonomy tree) and PlateRenderer injects an <svg><title> carrying the exact record name onto the plate's [data-structure=ctx-cerebral-cortex] group in the default author mode, where three authored plate SVGs also draw visible cortex labels ('Cerebral cortex (cortical ribbon)/(envelope)/(medial surface)'). PLAN 5 lines 289-296 flag the SVGs as outside every task's write list; the <title> is an extra surface for the integrator to decide. audit.mjs reports this as a scoped-honesty info line, never as a pass. F5 item 2 - solo(prosencephalon) on a fresh boot leaves 92/124 forebrain records drawable, exactly the same 92 as before the solo, because `hidden` (32 telencephalic ids from the brainstem-focus preset) is untouched by design; the store/legend/tree semantics themselves were verified independently (143 assertions, 0 failures, plus a forced load-time-assertion trip). F6 item 1 - the extent claim is NOT decidable from pixels: with the shipped default camera the helper sheets project far outside a 1500x950 viewport for the pre-v10 box AND the v10 box alike (three.js projection of the shipped bounds/camera: x-sheet bbox y -794..9637 px new vs -452..1441 px old), which is why Q1 reads the rendered geometry through the scene bridge; the authoritative extent gate remains verify:plane-helper-extent (196/0, executes the shipped render path with a bite proof). MINOR: Legend.tsx lost its trailing newline; the four division rows join .legend-row.legend-toggle (17 rows) though every existing exact-text probe still resolves uniquely (latent hazard only if a future division label equals a region/kind id); .legend-divisions/.legend-division/.legend-solo have no CSS rule so the Solo button is an unstyled UA button; SectionCanvas' label-anchor doc comment still says 'longest run' where the code now competes by drawn area and its `if (count < 3) continue` is unreachable. SCRIPT LINES THE INTEGRATOR STILL NEEDS (package.json is not mine): "verify:plane-helper-extent": "node scripts/verify/plane-helper-extent.mjs" and "verify:division-toggles": "node scripts/verify/division-toggles.mjs" (verify:cortical-lobes and verify:pip-contract already exist).
